# Voice Studio by sshconnect
> Free client-side Text-to-Speech & Image-to-Voice synthesis studio.

## Overview
Voice Studio (https://voice.sshconnect.space/) is a high-performance, minimalist web application designed for real-time Text-to-Speech synthesis and Image-to-Voice OCR extraction. Developed by Vedant Singh.

## Core Capabilities
- **Text-to-Speech (TTS):** Real-time vocal modulation (speed, pitch, volume, intonation) using browser-native Web Speech APIs.
- **Kinetic Teleprompter:** Synchronized real-time word highlighting following vocal cadence.
- **Image-to-Voice (OCR):** Client-side optical character recognition via Tesseract.js to extract text from images, receipts, and photos.
- **AI Scene Narration:** Optional multimodal image description powered by Google Gemini Vision.
- **Acoustic Spectrum Visualizer:** 60 FPS HTML5 Canvas harmonic equalizer (Bars, Waves, Core).
- **Multi-Language Locales:** 15+ international language dialects and phonetic sample scripts.
- **100% Client-Side Privacy:** Operates entirely in the browser with zero audio tracking or server storage.
